posts.author: Din
posts.content_md:
Problem set #1, Question 2:

Q. *What precautions should you take when working around the types of lasers we usein class? What laser class are they? What are the do's and don'ts? What are the potentialthreats or risks*

A. Do not look at laser with remaining eye. Do not point laser at people outside the lab. people may get the wrong idea when a red dot appears on their body (this is especially important for passing cops).

Question 3:

Q. *You’re exposing a hologram in the holography lab, and you hear the crashingsound of breaking glass coming from the darkroom?What should you do?*

A. Mop up as much of the beer/wine as you can.
